question: What is the percentage of posts whose owners had a reputation of over 1000 in 2011?
evidence: percentage = DIVIDE(COUNT(Id where YEAR(CreationDate) = 2011 and Reputation > 1000), COUNT(Id) ) * 100;
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching posts record.
gold: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(STRFTIME('%Y', T2.CreaionDate) = '2011' AND T1.Reputation > 1000, 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.Id) FROM users AS T1 LEFT JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId
gold0: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(STRFTIME('%Y', T2.CreaionDate) = '2011' AND T1.Reputation > 1000, 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.Id) FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId

d.request: What is the percentage of posts whose owners had a reputation of over 1000 in 2011, while also keeping the rows of users that have no matching posts record (i.e., using a join that doesn't drop users without posts)?
d.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', p.CreaionDate) = '2011' AND u.Reputation > 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(u.Id) FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId

b.request: Using all users as the base (keeping users with no matching posts), what percentage of them have a reputation over 1000 and posts created in 2011, relative to the total count of all users and their posts records, including users with no posts?
b.sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN u.Reputation > 1000 AND strftime('%Y', p.CreaionDate) = '2011' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(u.Id) AS percentage FROM users u LEFT JOIN posts p ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
